name: Hair Raiser
description: Ocean Park's intense floorless roller coaster in Thrill Mountain — riders' feet dangle freely beneath the open floorless trains as the coaster twists through steep drops, tight turns and high-speed inversions overlooking the South China Sea. One of the most thrilling attractions in Hong Kong and the undisputed centrepiece of Thrill Mountain. Min 140cm.

name: The Flash
description: A high-speed spinning coaster in Thrill Mountain themed around DC's Scarlet Speedster, sending riders through unpredictable spins and rapid direction changes at speed. One of the newest and most re-rideable thrill attractions at Ocean Park. Min 120cm.

name: Whirly Bird
description: A classic thrill ride spinning riders in aerial vehicles that swing outward with increasing speed, delivering dramatic centrifugal forces alongside spectacular views over the Aberdeen coastline. A Thrill Mountain favourite. Min 120cm.

name: Bumper Blaster
description: A fun and interactive bumper car experience in Marine World where guests navigate arena-style dodgems with playful collisions and quick reflexes needed to avoid being bumped. A reliable crowd-pleaser for all ages within the park's thrill offering. Min 110cm.

name: Rev Booster
description: A thrilling spinning tower ride that launches riders upward while rotating at speed, delivering a genuine adrenaline rush with sweeping views over Ocean Park and the harbour beyond. One of the more intense flat rides in the Thrill Mountain area. Min 130cm.

name: The Rapids
description: An exciting river rapids water ride where guests navigate a turbulent circular course in inflatable rafts, guaranteed to deliver a genuine soaking on a hot Hong Kong day. One of the most popular water attractions in the park. Min 100cm.

name: Flying Swing
description: A classic swing carousel ride lifting guests high above the park on spinning chains, delivering a joyful and accessible thrill with panoramic views across Ocean Park's Summit area. Suitable for most ages. Min 100cm.

name: Arctic Blast
description: A gentle family-friendly coaster themed to Polar Adventure, offering a first taste of roller coaster excitement for younger riders in an accessible, low-intensity format alongside the park's polar animal habitats. Min 90cm.

name: Sea Life Carousel
description: A beautifully decorated carousel themed to ocean creatures rather than horses, offering a gentle and visually charming ride for younger visitors and families in the Marine World area. Suitable for all ages.

name: Toto the Loco
description: A charming miniature train ride winding through Whiskers Harbour, Ocean Park's dedicated children's zone, offering a gentle and scenic first-ride experience perfect for the park's youngest visitors. Suitable for all ages.

name: Balloons Up-Up-And-Away
description: A gentle rising balloon ride in Whiskers Harbour where young riders control the height of their hot air balloon in a completely safe, joyful format designed specifically for the park's youngest guests. Suitable for all ages.

name: The Grand Aquarium
description: One of the largest aquariums in Asia, home to over 5,000 fish across more than 400 species, including a breathtaking 360-degree underwater viewing dome. A must-see attraction and one of Ocean Park's most celebrated experiences. Suitable for all ages.

name: Giant Panda Adventure
description: Home to Ocean Park's beloved giant pandas and red pandas, presented in a beautifully naturalistic habitat that recreates their native Chinese mountain forest environment. One of the most visited and cherished exhibits in the entire park. Suitable for all ages.

name: Cable Car
description: A spectacular scenic cable car journey connecting Ocean Park's Waterfront and Summit areas, offering breathtaking panoramic views across the South China Sea and Aberdeen coastline during the ride. One of the most memorable and photogenic experiences in the park. Suitable for all ages.

name: Shark Mystique
description: An immersive walkthrough exhibit bringing guests face-to-face with sand tiger sharks and other shark species through expansive viewing tunnels, combining education with genuine wonder. One of the most atmospheric marine exhibits at Ocean Park. Suitable for all ages.
